findings.next_step: Use official per-binary file/source mapping and current ELF inventory to close only this exact tuple; do not transfer disposition to libstdc++6 or third-party compiled C++ code.

findings.basis: Official exploit requires non-C/C.UTF8/POSIX locale plus untrusted LANGUAGE crossing a trust boundary and attacker-readable .mo catalog. Retained complete rootfs contains no usr/lib/locale, locale-archive or LC_MESSAGES tree; deployment uses C.UTF8. Official libc2.43-7 still lists vulnerable.
findings.next_step: Probe actual locale availability and effective environment/locale configuration on exact image; source-language/locale contract may prove not affected. Otherwise patch or retain unresolved. Upgrading libc alone does not resolve it.
